usage: The word 媽媽 (maa1 maa1) is commonly used to refer to one's mother in a familiar and affectionate way.
In sentences, 媽媽 usually acts as a noun and can be the subject or object.
You can use 媽媽 together with verbs to describe actions your mother does, e.g., 媽媽煮飯 (maa1 maa1 zyu2 faan6) - mum cooks.
When asking questions about your mother, 媽媽 is placed where a noun would normally go.
The word is often used in everyday speech and is informal compared to the more formal 母親 (mou5 can1).

examples.jyutping: maa1 maa1 hai2 uk1 kei2 zyu2 maan5 faan6.
examples.meaning: Mum is cooking dinner at home.
